title: roettlera reptans
intro: Roettlera reptans, commonly known as Indian tobacco or wild tobacco, is a flowering plant that belongs to the Lamiaceae family. It has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its ability to act as an expectorant, relieving respiratory issues such as bronchitis and coughs. The bioactive constituents of Roettlera reptans include iridoid glycosides, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. These therapeutic actions make Roettlera reptans a potential natural remedy for various health conditions, including respiratory issues, digestive problems, and skin conditions.
